name: Exp_ColorBullsGap
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorBullsGap custom indicator, which uses a dual-smoothing approach to detect bullish momentum gap signals. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from a neutral state to a bullish signal, and opens sell positions when it transitions from an overbought state to a bearish signal. Positions are managed with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorBullsGap自定义指标进行交易，该指标采用双重平滑方法检测看涨动量缺口信号。当指标从中性状态转为看涨信号时开多仓，当从超买状态转为看跌信号时开空仓。仓位可通过可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项进行管理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于ColorBullsGap指标，该指标使用两种不同的平滑算法对价格进行双重平滑处理来检测动量变化。入场条件：当指标缓冲区1的值从0变为大于0时产生买入信号，当值从2变为小于2时产生卖出信号，这本质上是捕捉动量从中性到看涨或从超买到看跌的转折点。出场条件：买入信号触发时同时平卖仓，卖出信号触发时同时平买仓，形成反向信号平仓机制，另外还有固定的止损和止盈出场。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额、基于净值、基于可用保证金和基于亏损保证金的比例计算。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode选择计算方式，默认使用固定手数模式。策略使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易，并通过BarsCalculated确保指标数据充分后才进行交易逻辑运算。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the ColorBullsGap indicator, which applies two different smoothing algorithms to price data for dual-smoothing momentum detection. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when indicator buffer 1 transitions from 0 to a value greater than 0, and a sell signal is generated when it transitions from 2 to a value less than 2, essentially capturing momentum shifts from neutral to bullish or from overbought to bearish. Exit conditions: a buy signal simultaneously closes sell positions and a sell signal closes buy positions, creating a reverse-signal exit mechanism, supplemented by fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance-based, equity-based, free margin-based, and loss-adjusted margin-based proportional calculation. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk proportion and MMMode for calculation method, defaulting to fixed lot mode. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated trading within the same bar and uses BarsCalculated to ensure sufficient indicator data before executing trading logic.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio, risk per trade

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数/余额/净值/可用保证金/亏损保证金）
parameters.description_en: MM mode: free margin/balance/loss margin/fixed lot

pros: 双重平滑算法组合（SMA+JJMA）提供更稳定的信号，减少噪音干扰
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活适应不同风险偏好
具备新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复开仓
买卖方向可独立开关控制，方便单方向测试和优化
使用反向信号平仓机制，确保持仓方向与当前信号一致
pros_en: Dual smoothing algorithm combination (SMA+JJMA) provides more stable signals with reduced noise
Multiple money management modes supported, flexibly adapting to different risk preferences
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated position opening within the same bar
Buy and sell directions can be independently toggled, facilitating unidirectional testing and optimization
Reverse-signal closing mechanism ensures position direction aligns with current signals
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点间距过大，在多数品种上可能不合适，缺乏动态止损机制
没有点差过滤，在小周期或高点差品种上可能产生不必要的亏损交易
缺乏持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
指标依赖iCustom调用自定义指标ColorBullsGap，部署时需要确保指标文件存在
没有最大持仓数限制和日内交易次数限制，极端行情下可能过度交易
cons_en: Stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively wide for most instruments, lacking dynamic stop mechanisms
No spread filter, potentially generating unnecessary losing trades on high-spread instruments or lower timeframes
Lacks position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Indicator depends on iCustom calling the ColorBullsGap custom indicator, requiring the indicator file to be present at deployment
No maximum position count or daily trade limit, risking overtrading during extreme market conditions
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓，并增加最大同时持仓数限制
引入动态止损机制（如追踪止损或基于ATR的止损），替代固定点数止损以适应不同市场波动性
improvements_en: Add position check logic to prevent duplicate same-direction openings and impose a maximum concurrent position limit
Introduce dynamic stop-loss mechanisms (e.g., trailing stop or ATR-based stop) instead of fixed point stops to adapt to varying market volatility

risk_points: 固定止损止盈点数过大，不同品种波动性差异大，可能导致止损过宽或过窄
缺乏同方向持仓检查，可能产生重复开仓导致过度暴露
没有点差过滤和交易时间过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
risk_points_en: Fixed stop-loss/take-profit points are very large; varying instrument volatility may make stops too wide or too narrow
Lacks same-direction position check, potentially creating duplicate openings and overexposure
No spread filter or trading session filter, potentially opening positions under unfavorable conditions
